title: The Clean Plate Club with Ronnie
description: Ronnie hosts a call-in cooking helpline and answers every kitchen disaster with total confidence and zero competence. Barry knows a recipe. Ronnie just adds more salt.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're cooking with Snazzie FM. It's The Clean Plate Club, where YOUR kitchen disaster becomes MY pleasure. The lines are open and the oven is preheated.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, do you, personally, know how to cook?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I know FLAVOR, Barry. The rest is just paperwork. Linda, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh thank goodness, okay, it's my first time hosting Thanksgiving, everyone's coming in two hours, and the turkey is still frozen SOLID. I don't know how to thaw it fast, I'm honestly about to cry.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Frozen turkey. Guests. Two hours. <p:0.3> Linda, you're not behind, you're AHEAD of the trend. Serve it frozen. Call it a rustic ice course.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That is not... you can thaw it in a sink of cold water, that actually...

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And if the ice tastes a little flat, Linda? Just add more salt to it.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: [question-en] Salt the... salt the ice?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: They'll be talking about it for years. Next caller, Mildred, welcome to the Club.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Hello dear. My grandkids are visiting and I wanted to make my late husband's famous chili, but I've lost the recipe. I just... I want it to taste like his did.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Mildred, that is beautiful, and I'm gonna be honest with you. <p:0.3> Don't make it. Order the chili from tonight's sponsor, Big Mike's Subs, now serving a chili.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, she doesn't want Big Mike's chili, she wants HIS...

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You know, no recipe ever tasted right to me after the divorce either, Mildred. Brenda took the cumin. Took the whole spice rack, actually. Took the rack.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Oh. I'm... I'm so sorry about Brenda?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Add more salt, Mildred. That's what he'd want. Darnell, you're on the Clean Plate Club.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Hey, so I just started as a line cook and I'm honestly terrified I'm gonna undercook the chicken and make somebody sick. How do you actually KNOW when chicken's done?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, Darnell. You just look at it. Color is a suggestion. A little pink keeps it juicy and builds the immune system.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: No! No, Darnell, one hundred and sixty five degrees, internal temperature, please use a thermometer.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Thermometers are fear-mongering, Barry. <p:0.3> And Darnell, if you're nervous? Add more salt. Salt kills everything.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I don't think that's how... that's not how salt works, man.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Confidence, Darnell. Plate it. Sal, you own a restaurant, talk to me.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Yeah, Ronnie, my signature marinara, suddenly it tastes off. I can't figure out what changed and I'm losing my regulars over it. What do I do?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, first thing, Sal. You take the fitted sheet, and you find the two corners with the seam. <p:0.3> Then you tuck one inside the... wait. Hang on.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, that's a different call. That was a laundry question last week.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You know what, Sal? The sauce is fine. The CUSTOMERS are the problem. Add more salt and charge them double for the privilege.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Double? They already hate it!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then they'll hate it expensively. Next. Gary, you sound stressed, go.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: RONNIE there's a fire, there's a grease fire on my stove RIGHT NOW, what do I do, what do I DO!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Gary. Gary, breathe. Fire is just flavor you can see. Lean into it.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Gary, NO, do not lean in, where is your fire extinguisher, lid on the pan, turn off the burner!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry's being dramatic. <p:0.3> Gary, throw salt on it. No. Throw ALL the salt on it. Every grain you own.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: It's getting BIGGER, oh no, oh no no no!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Because that's not how... HANG UP AND CALL THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, GARY!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And we've lost Gary's line. <p:0.3> Beautiful season of cooking, everybody.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's the third kitchen this season, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Third one that called BACK, Barry. <p:0.3> They love us.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: ...it spread.
